#config-version=FGT60F-7.4.2-FW-build2571-231219:opmode=0:vdom=0:user=claude-ro-cli
config system global
    set admintimeout 30
    set hostname "fw-01"
    set timezone "US/Central"
end
config system interface
    edit "wan1"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 203.0.113.10 255.255.255.248
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type physical
        set role wan
    next
    edit "internal"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping https ssh
        set type hard-switch
        set role lan
    next
    edit "iot"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.20.30.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set alias "IoT cameras"
        set role lan
        set interface "internal"
        set vlanid 30
    next
    edit "servers"
        set vdom "root"
        set ip 10.20.20.1 255.255.255.0
        set allowaccess ping
        set role lan
        set interface "internal"
        set vlanid 20
    next
end
config system admin
    edit "admin"
        set accprofile "super_admin"
        set vdom "root"
        set password ENC SH2nlSm7BqZ2rqOtlL0Yu2O8wVaLxGPWB9wRBdZf2YGdLJN6qGFrHC4rD0Hd18=
    next
    edit "netops-ro"
        set accprofile "read-only"
        set vdom "root"
        set trusthost1 192.168.1.0 255.255.255.0
        set password ENC SH2xyz=
    next
end
config vpn ssl settings
    set servercert "Fortinet_Factory"
    set tunnel-ip-pools "SSLVPN_TUNNEL_ADDR1"
    set source-interface "wan1"
    set source-address "all"
    set default-portal "full-access"
end
config firewall vip
    edit "rdp-jumphost"
        set extip 203.0.113.11
        set mappedip "10.20.20.15"
        set extintf "wan1"
        set portforward enable
        set extport 3389
        set mappedport 3389
    next
    edit "web-server"
        set extip 203.0.113.12
        set mappedip "10.20.20.80"
        set extintf "wan1"
        set portforward enable
        set extport 443
        set mappedport 443
    next
    edit "old-nas"
        set extip 203.0.113.13
        set mappedip "10.20.20.30"
        set extintf "wan1"
    next
end
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "LAN-to-Internet"
        set srcintf "internal"
        set dstintf "wan1"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set utm-status enable
        set ips-sensor "default"
        set logtraffic all
        set nat enable
    next
    edit 2
        set name "Inbound-RDP"
        set srcintf "wan1"
        set dstintf "internal"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "rdp-jumphost"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "RDP"
    next
    edit 3
        set name "Inbound-Web"
        set srcintf "wan1"
        set dstintf "servers"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "web-server"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
        set utm-status enable
        set ips-sensor "protect_http_server"
    next
    edit 4
        set name "IoT-to-LAN"
        set srcintf "iot"
        set dstintf "internal" "servers"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic disable
    next
    edit 5
        set name "temp-troubleshoot"
        set srcintf "any"
        set dstintf "any"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set status disable
    next
    edit 6
        set name "Old-NAS"
        set srcintf "wan1"
        set dstintf "servers"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "old-nas"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
    next
end
